(lambda (input)
  (let* ((nl (position #\Newline input))
         (name (subseq input 0 nl))
         (text (subseq input (1+ nl)))
         (best nil)
         (start 0))
    (loop
      (let ((pos (search "Created version " text :start2 start)))
        (unless pos (return))
        (let ((after (+ pos (length "Created version "))))
          ;; parse digits
          (let ((digits-end after))
            (loop while (and (< digits-end (length text))
                             (digit-char-p (char text digits-end)))
                  do (incf digits-end))
            (when (> digits-end after)
              ;; check " of "
              (let ((of-start digits-end))
                (when (and (>= (- (length text) of-start) 3)
                           (string= " of " text :start2 of-start :end2 (+ of-start 4)))
                  (let ((name-start (+ of-start 4)))
                    ;; name is non-space non-period chars, then "."
                    (let ((name-end name-start))
                      (loop while (and (< name-end (length text))
                                       (not (member (char text name-end) '(#\Space #\.))))
                            do (incf name-end))
                      (when (and (< name-end (length text))
                                 (char= (char text name-end) #\.))
                        (let ((cand-name (subseq text name-start name-end)))
                          (when (string= cand-name name)
                            (let ((n (parse-integer text :start after :end digits-end)))
                              (when (or (null best) (> n best)) (setf best n)))))))))))))
        (setf start (1+ after))))
    (if best (format nil "version ~d" best) "none")))
